stage: after 10-second support probe, before main load measurements

surfaceFrames.method: SurfaceFlinger --latency app BLAST surface, second column actual present nanoseconds; deduplicate; invalid 0 and INT64_MAX excluded
surfaceFrames.reason: Android observed normal presentation is 30 Hz on a 60 Hz display; allow ordinary pacing around 33.33 ms, at most one extra refresh at p95, and reject sustained visible stalls. Loading/transitions are reported separately.

input.methodStatus: screen-record input marker correlation pending support check; unsupported values remain unverified

memory.sameStateGrowthAtMost: max(32 MiB, 10% of warmed baseline) after returning to the same scene/state
memory.reason: Prototype should retain headroom on this device and avoid accumulating state over repeated UI/scene use; loading peaks reported separately.

thermal.reason: No severe or higher thermal throttling during continuous operation; battery temperature is descriptive only.

gc.criterion: valid allocation counter; report median/p95/max and total; investigate coincident presentation stalls; final GC remains unmeasured if no supported equivalent is available.
